design_style: Clean, structured layout with rounded containers, strong alignment, and consistent spacing. Use a white background.
icon_style: Line-style flat icons in white on blue circular backgrounds

usage.dark_slides_used_for: Section headers and primary category labels within content cards

rules: Use accent color #E8500A exclusively for slide titles only; never for body text or backgrounds
Use primary color #0072BC for section headers, card headers, and supporting UI elements like circles and banners
Font size must always be greater than 10
Ensure cards and layout patterns maintain sufficient white space
Always place a vertical dashed blue left border accent on key bullet lists to create visual hierarchy
Pair every major text block with an icon, illustration, or supporting diagram on the opposite side
Maintain minimum 40px margin on all sides and minimum 16px padding inside cards
Use chevron style bullet (›) or gear icon bullets consistently; do not mix with standard round bullets
All outcomes or summary rows must be visually distinguished with a blue left border or box outline
